what: The certificate behind the exact decision of the ξ′ constants of Alpöge–Furman (Remark 7.1; Lean: Zeta23/XiPrime/Certificate/{D1,Poly,AtOne}.lean): the diagonal density D₁(s) = s − 4s² + Σ_{k≥0} a_k s^{2k+3} with a_k = D1coeff k = 2·4^{k+1}·k!/(2k+2)! (the paper's Lemma 7.1), truncated at nine terms (k = 0..8) with the certified tail ε₉ = a_9·231/211 (the ratio a_{k+1}/a_k = 2(k+1)/((k+2)(2k+3)) is at most 20/231 from k = 9 on); the window integral J(v) = 2∫₀¹ D1trunc9(r)·vConv(r) dr with vConv(r) = ∫ v(t) v(t + r) dt the window's autocorrelation; κ₉(v) = (∫v² + J(v))/(∫v)²; and the constants 2 − κ₉ − ε₉ (simple, on the line) and 3/2 − (κ₉ + ε₉)/2 (distinct). The flat window is v = 1 on [−1/2, 1/2] (vConv = 1 − r, ∫v = ∫v² = 1); the quartic window is v(s) = 1 − (7/100)(2s)² − (51/200)(2s)⁴ on [−1/2, 1/2]. Written by the mathematician of the session (corpus/riemann/mathematician.md §4), 2026-10-22, from the definitions those files print; every number below was re-derived here with exact fractions, independently of the Lean's computer-algebra-generated closed forms.
vQuarticNote: the coefficients of v(s) = 1 − (7/100)(2s)² − (51/200)(2s)⁴ in powers of s: 1, 0, −28/100, 0, −816/200
vConvQuarticNote: the coefficients b_0..b_9 of vConv(r) = ∫_{-1/2}^{1/2-r} v(t) v(t+r) dt for 0 ≤ r ≤ 1, derived here by exact polynomial arithmetic (the Lean's Poly.lean prints the same degree-9 polynomial); b_0 = ∫v² and Σ b_l = vConv(1) = 0 are the consistency checks the receiver decides from these bytes
